Absolute https URL with matching text renders as autolink (#397)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<a href=\"https://example.com\">https://example.com</a>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
